mechanism: Carbamazepine induces CYP450 enzymes that may increase methimazole metabolism, while methimazole can rarely cause agranulocytosis and carbamazepine also carries hematologic risk, creating additive bone marrow suppression potential.
action: Monitor complete blood counts regularly; consider alternative anticonvulsant if possible; ensure adequate thyroid function monitoring as carbamazepine may alter thyroid hormone metabolism.
